svg.title: One monitoring connection, three views
svg.desc: The composition Wire connects Node Exporter's node-metrics Anchor, which provides the interface, to Prometheus's scrape-target Anchor, which requires it. A materializer writes the Node Exporter endpoint into Prometheus's scrape configuration. The runtime panel reads left to right from Prometheus, the HTTP client and consumer, to Node Exporter, the HTTP server and provider. The Wire connects provider to consumer; the HTTP request goes from consumer to provider.
